exceptions.reason: Every @atproto/* package that the AT Protocol browser OAuth client depends on still requires zod ^3, and no zod 3 release carries the 4.6.6 fix. The advisory is a memory-exhaustion denial of service while validating an attacker-supplied oversized array. In this frontend zod only validates OAuth and identity documents fetched from the account holder's own PDS inside their browser tab; no server or other visitor is affected. Remove this entry as soon as @atproto/oauth-client-browser depends on zod >=4.6.6.
